title: Кто отец Кости  (Who Is Kostya's Father)

segments.t: At Kostya and Nastya's apartment, Nastya proudly tells Kostya's visiting grandmother that she tracked down Kostya's long-lost father, who is currently at the zoo with Kostya and little Styopa. But when the grandmother sees his photo, she says that man is not Kostya's father.
В остальном у нас всё хорошо.
Костя с папой пошли в зоопарк.
Как это может быть не он?
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
В остальном у нас всё хорошо.
'Otherwise everything is fine with us.' The grammar packs 'remaining' and 'well' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'And where is my grandson right now?' Notice how Russian expresses 'and' and 'grandson' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Nastya answers right away.
Костя с папой пошли в зоопарк.
'Kostya and his dad went to the zoo.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'Kostya' before landing on 'zoo'.
'Wait, with what dad?' The meaning hinges on 'wait' working together with 'dad' in spoken Russian.
'Did Kostya really not tell you?' The '-l' ending on the verb meaning 'told' places the action in the masculine past tense.
'I recently found his dad.' Nastya brings out the contrast between 'I' and 'recently' in a few short words.
'Kostik is so very glad now.' Notice how Russian expresses 'now' and 'glad' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'Why, this is not Kostya's father!' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'so' before landing on 'bones'. Nastya answers right away.
Как это может быть не он?
'How could it not be him?' The negative particle sits right before the verb meaning 'be' to negate the statement.
'Tell me for sure, is it him or not?' The grammar packs 'say' and 'no' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'Mom, I will call you back later.' Notice how Russian expresses 'mom' and 'I will call back' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. the guest answers right away.
'Nastya, set the table quickly!' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'Nastya' before landing on 'table'. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.
В остальном у нас всё хорошо.
Костя с папой пошли в зоопарк.
Как это может быть не он?
Just as Kostya and his supposed father return from the zoo, the series finale awaits with one last Michelin inspection. See you next time!
